U = E − Ir（纵截距 E、斜率绝对值 r）: U = E − Ir (U-intercept E, slope magnitude r)
一节旧干电池的电动势和内阻，怎么用一只电压表、一只电流表和一个滑动变阻器「测」出: How do you "measure" the EMF and internal resistance of an old dry cell with one voltmeter, one ammeter and a rheostat? With a different circuit, do you get the same result?
开关合上、滑片先放在最大阻值处，回路里有电流：I 最小、U 最大: Close the switch with the slider at maximum resistance first; current flows: I smallest, U largest
每一组 U、I 都满足 U = E − Ir：I 越大 U 越小: Every U, I pair satisfies U = E − Ir: the larger I, the smaller U
滑片从 20.0 Ω 减到 2.0 Ω，记 5 组（与教材表 1 同量级）: Move the slider from 20.0 Ω down to 2.0 Ω and record 5 sets (similar to textbook Table 1)

电表有内阻，接法决定 E测、r测 偏大还是偏小: Meters have internal resistance, and the circuit decides whether E_meas and r_meas come out high or low

拖视角绕实验台看一圈：顺导线走完「电池 → 开关 → 电流表 → 变阻器 → 回: Drag the view around the bench and follow the wire around: "cell → switch → ammeter → rheostat → back to cell"
电压表量程 0〜3 V、电流表 0〜0.6 A、变阻器 0〜20 Ω；开关断开时: Voltmeter range 0–3 V, ammeter 0–0.6 A, rheostat 0–20 Ω; with the switch open both meters read 0.00 (U = 0.00 V, I = 0.00 A, both needles at zero); the slider is at 8.0 Ω (middle).
The voltmeter is across "cell + switch" and the ammeter is in series in the "rheostat" branch (textbook Fig. 12.3-1); the rheostat is used as a current limiter, connecting just one end and the slider. With the switch open the voltmeter reads 0.00 V, not E; E has to be extrapolated from the intercept of the U-I line.

电流表串在「电流表 + 变阻器」这条支路里，变阻器按限流用（只用一端 + 滑片两: The ammeter is in series in the "ammeter + rheostat" branch, and the rheostat is a current limiter (only one end and the slider are used).

器材辨认与接线是必做实验 12 的第一项能力（课标 p.42）；会读双量程指针表: Identifying equipment and wiring is the first skill of required experiment 12 (curriculum standard p.42); read the range of a dual-range needle meter.

滑片在 20.0 Ω、开关合上（教材图 12.3-1 + p.91 参考案例 1: Slider at 20.0 Ω, switch closed (textbook Fig. 12.3-1 + p.91 reference case 1, steps 1 and 2): U = 1.46 V, I = 0.07 A (Table 1 row 1, ideal meters); the short-circuit current E/r = 2.50 A, 4 times the ammeter's 0.6 A range.
教材的操作顺序：先按图接线、把阻值调到较大，再闭合开关、逐渐减小（p.91）；理: The textbook's order: wire up per the diagram and set the resistance high, then close the switch and gradually reduce it (p.91); the reason is "never connect the two terminals of a source directly with a wire" (p.87). With R down to 0 the short-circuit current is 2.50 A, pinning the meter and heating the source.
facts A3.2 第 1、2 步、A2.15、A2.11、B1.1；表 1: facts A3.2 steps 1, 2, A2.15, A2.11, B1.1; Table 1 row 1; Fig. 12.3-1 (p.89)
顺序是考点：先接线 → 滑片到最大 → 合开关 → 逐渐减小。: The order is tested: wire up → slider to maximum → close switch → gradually reduce.
R 越小 I 越大、U 越小，两个读数必须同时读。: The smaller R, the larger I and the smaller U; read both meters at the same time.
R 不能到 0：短路电流 2.50 A 是量程的 4 倍，p.87 明令禁止短接: R can't go to 0: the 2.50 A short-circuit current is 4 times the range, and p.87 forbids shorting.

按 20.0 → 14.0 → 10.0 → 6.0 → 2.0 Ω 依次减小滑: Reduce the slider through 20.0 → 14.0 → 10.0 → 6.0 → 2.0 Ω, pressing "Record" once at each stop
五组记录（图 12.3-1 + p.91 第 3 步）：(0.07 A, 1.4: Five records (Fig. 12.3-1 + p.91 step 3): (0.07 A, 1.46 V), (0.10, 1.44), (0.14, 1.42), (0.23, 1.36), (0.58, 1.15) (Table 1); the larger I, the smaller U; at 2.0 Ω the slider warns "any lower is close to a short circuit; the short-circuit current is 2.50 A".
只测两组「看起来比较简单，误差却可能较大；只有多次测量，并对数据进行处理，才能减: Measuring only two sets "looks simpler, but the error can be large; only repeated measurement with data processing reduces error" (p.89), so use the rheostat to change the external resistance and measure several sets. U falls as I rises because the potential drop Ir across the internal resistance grows (p.86).
facts A2.6、A2.12、A3.2 第 3 步、B1.1、B2.1 第: facts A2.6, A2.12, A3.2 step 3, B1.1, B2.1 item 11; Table 1
5 组要从大到小改变阻值，让 I 的跨度尽量大（0.07 → 0.58 A）。: Change the resistance from large to small over the 5 sets to make the range of I as wide as possible (0.07 → 0.58 A).
记的是表上的读数（U、I），不是用 E、r 算出来的数。: Record the meter readings (U, I), not numbers calculated from E and r.
I 越大 U 越小，因为内阻上的 Ir 变大。: The larger I, the smaller U, because Ir across the internal resistance grows.
去掉这一步：只测两组就去联立，误差会被放大到 0.06 Ω（第 6 步）。: Skip this step and solving with just two sets magnifies the error to 0.06 Ω (step 6).

教材图 12.3-2（p.90）的网格与描点，数据取表 1 的 5 行：5 个点: The grid and points of textbook Fig. 12.3-2 (p.90), using the 5 rows of Table 1: the 5 points lie on a line with negative slope; the fit gives E_meas = 1.50 V (U-intercept), slope −0.61, r_meas = 0.61 Ω, I_sc = 1.50/0.61 = 2.46 A.

facts A2.1–A2.5、A2.8、B2.1 第 5、7 条；表 1 拟合: facts A2.1–A2.5, A2.8, B2.1 items 5, 7; Table 1 fit, Table 6 row 2; Fig. 12.3-2 (p.90)

0 起时 5 个点被压成屏幕下方一小团（U 只在 1.15〜1.46 V 之间，: Starting at 0, the 5 points are squeezed into a small cluster at the bottom (U only spans 1.15–1.46 V, less than a third of the 3 V range); starting at the data floor of 1.15 V they spread out and the slope is easy to read; with both starts the U-intercept is E_meas = 1.50 V and the slope −0.61; the line itself doesn't move.
干电池内阻小、U 变化小，所以作图时「电压轴的起点坐标一般不从 0 开始」，应根: Dry cells have small internal resistance and U changes little, so when plotting "the voltage axis generally doesn't start at 0" and the start should be chosen from the data (p.91); changing the axis range doesn't change the line, so p.90 asks "does the intercept change?". It doesn't (p.90 asks without answering; it follows from the equation), and the intercept is still E.
facts A2.9、A7.3、A7.11、A2.3；表 1（U 最小 1.15: facts A2.9, A7.3, A7.11, A2.3; Table 1 (lowest U 1.15 V)

起点只改坐标范围，直线和截距都不变。: The start only changes the axis range; the line and intercept stay the same.
数据挤在一小团时，要会说「调坐标轴范围」，而不是「数据不行」。: When the data are crowded together, say "adjust the axis range", not "the data are bad".

表 1 前两行 (0.07 A, 1.46 V)、(0.10 A, 1.44 V: Table 1's first two rows (0.07 A, 1.46 V), (0.10 A, 1.44 V): the two-point method gives E_meas = 1.51 V, r_meas = 0.67 Ω; compared with the 5-set fit of 1.50 V / 0.61 Ω, r is 0.06 Ω high (about 6 in the last digit). Using the first and last sets instead returns 1.50 V / 0.61 Ω.
两点联立在数学上成立，但读数只到 0.01、两组之间 I 只差 0.03 A，Δ: Solving two points simultaneously is mathematically fine, but readings go only to 0.01 and the two sets differ by just 0.03 A in I, so ΔU is only 2 in the last digit and dividing magnifies the error; that's why the textbook requires repeated measurements. The wider the span of the points, the closer the two-point method gets to the five-point method.
facts A2.6、A2.7、A7.1、B2.1 第 6 条；表 1 前两行: facts A2.6, A2.7, A7.1, B2.1 item 6; Table 1 first two rows
两点法数学上对，但读数只有 0.01，ΔU 只有 2 个末位。: The two-point method is mathematically correct, but readings only go to 0.01 and ΔU is just 2 in the last digit.

把「电表」拨到真实（3 kΩ / 0.1 Ω），按 5 档重记（每档点一次「记录: Switch "Meters" to real (3 kΩ / 0.1 Ω), re-record at the 5 stops (pressing "Record" once at each), then compare with the analytical formula
教材接法 + 真实电表、滑片 2.0 Ω：电表在理想档时 U = 1.15 V、: Textbook circuit + real meters, slider at 2.0 Ω: with ideal meters U = 1.15 V, I = 0.58 A; switched to real, U = 1.17 V, I = 0.56 A (0.02 V apart, which is the ammeter's 0.1 Ω); r_meas changes from 0.61 Ω to 0.59 Ω (just 1 in the last digit). Analytically k = 3000/3000.6 = 0.99980 → E_meas = 1.49970 V, r_meas = 0.59988 Ω, both low by the same 0.0200 %.
教材接法的偏差是 E测、r测 都偏小、同比例；偏差比 0.01 的读数末位小 3: With the textbook circuit, E_meas and r_meas are both low by the same proportion; the bias is 33 / 83 times smaller than the last digit of a 0.01 reading and simply invisible in 2-decimal readings, so the textbook text doesn't discuss it and spends its effort on repeated measurement, plotting and the y-axis start. The direction can only be calculated, not seen in readings (analytical derivation, not discussed in this textbook section, L3).
